title: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Speaker and Deputy Speaker s Saleries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 2015

sections.shortTitle: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Speaker and Deputy Speaker s Saleries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 2015
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA SPEAKER AND DEPUTY SPEAKER S (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES
AND PRIVILEGES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA SPEAKER AND DEPUTY SPEAKER S (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES
AND PRIVILEGES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015
An Act further to
amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Speaker and Deputy
Speaker s (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975.
1. Short title and commencement.---(1)
This Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Speaker
and Deputy Speaker s (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges (Amendment) Act,
2015.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.description:
Amendment of section 7 of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. III of 1975

KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA SPEAKER AND DEPUTY SPEAKER S (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES
AND PRIVILEGES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA SPEAKER AND DEPUTY SPEAKER S (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES
AND PRIVILEGES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2015
An Act further to
amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Speaker and Deputy
Speaker s (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975.
2. Amendment of section 7 of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Act No. III of 1975.--- In the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Speaker and Deputy Speaker s (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Act No. III of 1975), in section 7, in sub-section (2), for the words one hundred
thousand , the words ten hundred thousand shall be substituted.
BY ORDER OF MR. SPEAKER
